rec.name: PDP Review Spotlight (Review Carousel Block)
rec.status: Built — launched (dev-tested by Kian & Chris; setup video and TXT install guide available)

what.text: A compact review carousel block placed in the PDP buy box, directly under the product title/price area and above the variant picker and add-to-cart button. Each slide shows a 5-star rating row (filled stars in the accent color, empty stars greyed), a bold one-line review title and a short review text. It sits on a light grey background with pagination dots underneath. Up to 10 hand-picked reviews per product are supplied via a metaobject linked to the product by a metafield. The original ticket described it as a 'Section'; the final build is a block inside the main-product section.

why.text: Social proof placed right next to the purchase decision lets shoppers see real customer voices without scrolling to the review section lower on the page. Hand-picking the best reviews per product (with a short headline and a star rating) lets the team highlight the objections and benefits that matter most. This reduces perceived risk at the moment of the add-to-cart decision. A swipeable carousel keeps the block compact so it does not push the CTA down the page.

how.text: 1) In main-product.liquid, add a new block schema 'CRO | Review Spotlight' (type cro_review_spotlight, limit 1) with the settings below. 2) Create the snippet/section cro_review_spotlight.liquid. It reads the product metafield standard.cro_pdp_review_spotlight, loops over 1..10, and renders a slide only when the title_N field is not blank. Each slide shows filled stars (rating_N) plus empty stars (5 minus rating) using the theme's 'rating-star' icon, then the title and content. Slides are wrapped in the theme's <flickity-carousel> with a config built from the block settings (adaptiveHeight, draggable, fade, autoPlay, pageDots, wrapAround, no prev/next buttons). Styling is injected via a <style> tag using the block settings. 3) In product-form.liquid, add a `when 'cro_review_spotlight'` case that renders the snippet with product and block. 4) In Shopify admin, create a Metaobject definition 'CRO | Review Spotlight' (type cro_review_spotlight) with a Name field (display name) and 10 sets of Rating N (integer 1–5), Title N (single-line text) and Content N (multi-line text). 5) Create a product metafield definition 'CRO | PDP | Review Spotlight' (standard.cro_pdp_review_spotlight, Mixed reference, limited to the metaobject, one entry). 6) Per product, create a metaobject entry with the reviews and assign it to the metafield. Then add the block in the theme editor.

items: Empty rating color (default #D9D9D9; note: the code's setting id is spelled 'emptry_rating_color')
Heading font size desktop and mobile 8–36px (default 16)
Content font size desktop and mobile 8–36px (default 16)
Per review (in metaobject): rating 1–5, title, content; up to 10 reviews

dependencies.text: Needs the metaobject definition 'CRO | Review Spotlight' (cro_review_spotlight) and the product metafield 'CRO | PDP | Review Spotlight' (standard.cro_pdp_review_spotlight, Mixed reference) with the Storefront API access option enabled. Theme assumptions: main-product.liquid with a block schema, a product-form.liquid snippet with a block case statement, the <flickity-carousel> custom element (Flickity), and an 'icon' snippet with a 'rating-star' icon. Not installable by non-devs. Note: the original ticket asked for rich text (bold/italic/underline) in the headline/sub-headline and a section-level star count and color, but the final build uses plain-text title and content with weight/style settings. Another inconsistency: the metafield key is shown as standard.cro_review_spotlight in an earlier comment and in the screenshot, and as standard.cro_pdp_review_spotlight in the final code file.

items: Scroll depth to the reviews section
